{
  "name": "cache-keep-warm",
  "displayName": "Cache Keep-Warm",
  "version": "1.0.8",
  "description": "Shows how long your session's prompt cache stays warm, and can keep it warm in the background while you are away",
  "author": {
    "name": "AndreiC81",
    "url": "https://github.com/andreichiritescu"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/andreichiritescu/claude-code-cache-keep-warm",
  "repository": "https://github.com/andreichiritescu/claude-code-cache-keep-warm",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "prompt-cache",
    "cache",
    "keep-warm",
    "countdown",
    "mod"
  ],
  "icon": "./docs/images/icon.png",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/andreichiritescu/claude-code-cache-keep-warm#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/andreichiritescu/claude-code-cache-keep-warm/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/andreichiritescu/claude-code-cache-keep-warm#what-it-runs-reads-and-sends",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://github.com/andreichiritescu/claude-code-cache-keep-warm/blob/main/LICENSE",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "title_mark": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Mark the session title",
      "description": "While keep-warm is on, put a green dot in front of the session's title in the desktop app's session list",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
